data.name: Arg_Invalid_MonetaryContextNameBlank
data.value: The monetary-context name must not be empty or white space.
data.comment: ArgumentException thrown when a monetary-context name supplied to a builder method is empty or white space.

data.name: IO_KeyNotFound_MonetaryContext
data.value: No monetary context is configured or registered under the name '{0}'.
data.comment: KeyNotFoundException thrown by IMonetaryContextResolver.Get for an unknown name. {0} is the name.

data.name: Op_Invalid_DefaultMonetaryContextOptions
data.value: The default monetary context in the financial options is not valid: {0}
data.comment: Validation failure reported in an OptionsValidationException. {0} is the message of the exception the context's settings raised.

data.name: Op_Invalid_MonetaryContextOptions
data.value: The monetary context '{0}' in the financial options is not valid: {1}
data.comment: Validation failure reported in an OptionsValidationException. {0} is the context name; {1} is the message of the exception its settings raised.

data.name: Op_Invalid_MonetaryContextOptionsMissing
data.value: The monetary context '{0}' in the financial options has no settings.
data.comment: Validation failure reported in an OptionsValidationException when a named context's settings are null. {0} is the context name.

data.name: Op_Invalid_MonetaryContextOptionsNameBlank
data.value: A monetary context in the financial options has an empty or white-space name.
data.comment: Validation failure reported in an OptionsValidationException when a named context's name is empty or white space.
